claims.claim: Dealer in all kinds of Japanese parts and gearbox
claims.evidence: No shop signage, business registration, or inventory shot to confirm dealer status.
No import documents, customs sticker, or shipping manifest visible in any photo.
No video of the unit running, shifting, or being bench-tested; only static dusty shots.
Requires audio/video of unit under load; photos are silent and static.
Transmissions have no odometer; no donor-vehicle mileage document or VIN shown.
No close-up of casing bolts/seals to confirm factory-torque marks or absence of re-sealing.

risks.risk: Internal gear/clutch pack wear or damage not visible from outside
risks.proof: Video of unit being spun/tested on a bench rig or installed and shifting through gears
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown internal condition, worst case

risks.risk: Unit may be incomplete (missing torque converter, solenoids, sensors)
risks.proof: Full-angle photo showing torque converter installed and all sensor ports populated

risks.risk: Compatibility with buyer's specific vehicle unknown
risks.proof: Photo of ID/data plate or chassis tag matching donor vehicle
risks.if_unproven: priced as unconfirmed fitment, buyer assumes compatibility risk

risks.risk: Fluid condition/leaks not assessable from dry exterior shots
risks.proof: Photo of dipstick fluid color or a leak-test on a mat after running

risks.risk: Transmission type (automatic vs manual) not confirmed
risks.proof: Clear shot of shift pattern tag or bellhousing bolt count matching known spec
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lower-value type until confirmed

risks.risk: Origin/mileage claims unverifiable, common fraud pattern in Tokunbo claims
risks.proof: Photo of import paperwork, customs clearance, or odometer/donor vehicle mileage record
risks.if_unproven: priced as standard used unit, ignoring unverified origin premium

proof_requests: Video of the transmission running or shifting on a test rig
Close-up of data/ID plate or bellhousing bolt pattern for type confirmation
Photo of torque converter and all sensor/solenoid ports
Photo of fluid level/color via dipstick
Any import/customs documentation supporting Belgium origin claim
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a used transmission/gearbox assembly, so it can be priced at worst case given unverified condition, completeness, and origin claims.
